title: EviSeek: An Evidence-Centric Agentic Framework for Embodied Active Information Seeking
abstract: arXiv:2611.06434v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Active embodied question answering requires agents to acquire evidence through viewpoint changes and physical interaction. The central challenge is to avoid undirected interaction: taking plausible actions without specifying what evidence they should reveal for answering the question. Action plans and accumulated histories alone can leave the informational purpose of an interaction implicit. We introduce EviSeek, a training-free framework that makes question-derived evidence demands explicit acquisition objectives, linking observation-conditioned actions and selectively retained evidence to the information the agent seeks. On 3,436 ESI-Bench questions, EviSeek improves accuracy over the Single-model agent by 7.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL-32B and 3.7 points with Gemini 3.1 Pro, while improving visual-support-weighted accuracy and reducing mean token usage. These findings support making the informational purpose of interaction explic

translated_title: EviSeek：一个以证据为中心的具身主动信息获取智能体框架
translated_abstract: 主动具身问答要求智能体通过视角变化和物理交互来获取证据。其核心挑战在于避免无方向的交互：即采取看似合理的行动，却没有明确这些行动应为回答问题揭示何种证据。仅依靠行动计划和累积的历史记录，可能会使交互的信息目的变得隐晦。我们提出了 EviSeek，这是一个无需训练的框架，它将从问题中推导出的证据需求转化为明确的获取目标，将基于观察条件的动作和选择性保留的证据与智能体所寻求的信息联系起来。在 ESI-Bench 的 3,436 个问题上，EviSeek 使用 Qwen3-VL-32B 将准确率相比单模型智能体提升了 7.1 个百分点，使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 提升了 3.7 个百分点，同时提高了视觉支持加权准确率并降低了平均 token 使用量。这些发现支持了将交互的信息目的显式化的做法。
tldr: EviSeek 是一个无需训练的以证据为中心的智能体框架，通过将问题中蕴含的证据需求转化为明确的获取目标，引导具身智能体进行有目的的主动信息获取，在 ESI-Bench 上显著提升问答准确率并降低 token 消耗。
